findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ua_law__get_unit_in_force, ua_echr__get_case · Private data: ua_law__search, ua_law__get_document, ua_law__get_unit, ua_law__get_document_toc, ua_edrsr__get_document, ua_edrsr__lookup_case, ua_bankruptcy__get_case, ua_edr_companies__lookup, ua_edr_companies__search_fop, ua_edr_companies__lookup_fop, un_sanctions__search, ua_echr__get_case, ua_corruption_registry__search, ua_vs_digest__search, ua_vs_digest__document · Public sink: catalog__describe · Destructive: ua_law__get_unit, catalog__call.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ua_law__get_unit_in_force, ua_echr__get_case · Private data: ua_law__search, ua_law__get_document, ua_law__get_unit, ua_law__get_document_toc, ua_edrsr__get_document, ua_edrsr__lookup_case, ua_bankruptcy__get_case, ua_edr_companies__lookup, ua_edr_companies__search_fop, ua_edr_companies__lookup_fop, un_sanctions__search, ua_echr__get_case, ua_corruption_registry__search, ua_vs_digest__search, ua_vs_digest__document · Public sink: catalog__describe · Destructive: ua_law__get_unit, catalog__call

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
